attribution.changes: Reproject a measured pixel-window crop to a local Mars azimuthal-equidistant grid at 1 m; reverse rows to north-increasing local y; subtract minimum height for local z; quantize to UE r16. Registered grayscale orthoimage is a separate unlit reference, not albedo. No invented relief or rocks.
